channel.title: verox
channel.description: Cybersecurity writeups, research, and thoughts by verox.

item.title: hc0n Christmas CTF
item.description: A long-form challenge chaining web enumeration, CBC padding-oracle abuse, credential discovery, binary analysis, and buffer overflow exploitation.

item.title: Agent P
item.description: A multi-stage chain moves from WordPress SQL injection through database credentials, unsafe pickle loading, and a signed-task binary to root.

item.title: Lost Fortune Included
item.description: A PHP stream-wrapper bypass defeats the document whitelist and reads arbitrary files from the server.

item.title: B1t Recovery
item.description: Known plaintext from the THM flag prefix recovers a reused four-byte XOR key and decrypts the challenge file.

item.title: Casino Heist
item.description: Packet-capture analysis and PyInstaller reverse engineering recover the key used to decrypt exfiltrated jackpot data.

item.title: Fresh Powder
item.description: A detection-as-code investigation repairs five broken Sigma rules and validates each fix against the incident report.

item.title: Beach Bar
item.description: Leaked credentials lead to unsafe YAML deserialization, remote code execution, and Linux privilege escalation.

item.title: Do Not Disturb
item.description: A NoSQL authentication bypass opens an EJS SSTI path, followed by debugger hijacking and privilege escalation.

item.title: Hollow Shell
item.description: Default credentials and a Zip Slip upload escape the theme directory and turn an automation hook into code execution.

item.title: Infinity Pool
item.description: Command injection in a legacy network-check endpoint leads through internal services to full compromise.

item.title: Room 404
item.description: An exposed .git directory leaks the staging source and a flag left in the repository.

item.title: The Guestbook
item.description: Prompt injection against an AI concierge reveals hidden directives and bypasses output redaction.

item.title: Towel on the Sunbed
item.description: A race condition lets parallel reward claims bypass the 24-hour lock and open the Whale Vault.

item.title: Eavesdropper
item.description: SSH access as Frank and process monitoring with pspy reveal credentials used for root privilege escalation.

item.title: Umbrella
item.description: An exposed Docker registry leaks database credentials, leading through cracked hashes, command injection, and a privileged container to root.

item.title: Cupid’s Matchmaker
item.description: Stored XSS in a matchmaking survey steals the reviewer’s session cookie and exposes the flag.

item.title: Corp Website
item.description: CVE-2025-55182 provides remote code execution before a permissive sudo path completes privilege escalation.

item.title: CupidBot
item.description: The bot leaks its verification code, which can be replayed to authorize disclosure of all three challenge flags.

item.title: Speed Chatting
item.description: An unrestricted profile-image upload accepts executable Python and turns a chat account into a reverse shell.

item.title: TryHeartMe
item.description: An improperly protected JWT lets a normal shopper forge an admin role and redeem the staff-only flag.
